skill.name: Fire Style - Great Dragon Fire Jutsu
skill.desc: At the beginning of odd rounds, causes unavoidable damage and <font color="#4dc831">Level 2 - Ignition</font> to up to 4 units in the lineup in front. At the beginning of even rounds, executes <font color="#4dc831">Great Dragon Fire - Blaze Infusion</font>.

skill.name: Great Dragon Fire - Blaze Infusion
skill.desc: At the beginning of even rounds, causes unavoidable damage, <font color="#4dc831">Amaterasu Blaze</font> and <font color="#4dc831">Level 2 - Ignition</font> to up to 4 units in the lineup in front.

skill.name: The Two Great Visual Jutsu
skill.desc: Whenever Sasuke suffers the first <font color="#4dc831">Trigger</font> damage in a round, executes <font color="#4dc831">Genjutsu - Mangekyo Sharingan</font>. Whenever Sasuke suffers <font color="#4dc831">Mystery</font> damage, executes <font color="#4dc831">Genjutsu - Rinnegan</font>, can be triggered 4 times each round.

skill.name: Susano'o - Dominance
skill.desc: Sasuke has <font color="#4dc831">Super Armor</font>, is <font color="#4dc831">immune to Debuffs</font>, can use 2 Mystery skills every other round and his first 2 Mystery damage received each round is reduced by 40%. While Sasuke is alive, the first 2 <font color="#4dc831">Pure Taijutsu</font> damage your lineup receives every round is reduced by 50% and whenever they execute a <font color="#4dc831">Chase</font>, scale Sasuke's <font color="#4dc831">Ninjutsu</font> by 18% and <font color="#4dc831">Critical Rate</font> by 7%.

skill.name: Kirin
skill.desc: Causes unavoidable damage and <font color="#4dc831">Electrocution</font> to all units in the opponent's lineup, causes <font color="#4dc831">Interruption</font> to the selected unit. After this skill is executed, increase Sasuke's Trigger damage by 20% (stackable up to 100%) and his Mystery changes to <font color="#4dc831">Kirin - Blaze Infusion</font>.

skill.name: Kirin - Blaze Infusion
skill.desc: Causes unavoidable damage, <font color="#4dc831">Amaterasu Blaze</font> to all units in the opponent's lineup and dispels their <font color="#4dc831">Perseverance</font>, causes <font color="#4dc831">Interruption</font> to the selected unit and locks that unit's Mystery Cooldown to 1 until the end of the next round. After this skill is executed, Sasuke's Mystery changes to <font color="#4dc831">Kirin</font>.
